messages:
Alex M.: quick check — marking SDK quickstarts/docs for a soft freeze tomorrow 09:00 PT. need owners to confirm any last-minute breaking deps or sample-app PRs that must land before cutoff. @Priya S. @Mateo R. @Jin K. :wave:
Priya S.: sample apps: 3/4 ready. mobile-auth sample needs the new auth helper (PR #482). I can cut a patch but needs review. ETA end of today. :hourglass_flowing_sand:
Mateo R.: on it. pinged reviewers in #eng. PR #482 has a failing unit test in auth_cli; looks flaky but reproducible locally. I can debug after standup. if it lands, we need docs snippet update for init flow.
Jin K.: docs impact noted — if PR #482 lands we should update quickstart step 2, change code block to use `AuthClient.init({env: process.env.REDWOOD_ENV})`. I can prepare a tiny PR against docs repo, but want to avoid churn during freeze.
Alex M.: plan: accept non-breaking docs-only PRs until cutoff, but binary/dep changes must be reviewed + green CI. please label urgent PRs with `devex/critical-before-freeze` so release team can triage.
Mateo R.: labeling now. also tagging QA for smoke run: QA-bot can we run the sample apps smoke test against the staging sdk-artifact (build 202)?
QA-bot: scheduled smoke run triggered: sample-apps-staging build=202, matrix=android,web,server. results ETA ~12m. logs: https://ci.internal/runs/6789 :mag:
Priya S.: quick note — sample-app android needs a newer okhttp; that's a runtime change (minor). if we upgrade, bumping sample container image required. that feels like more than a docs tweak. advise delay unless critical.
Alex M.: decision: postpone okhttp upgrade until after release unless it blocks local devs. prioritize getting auth helper PR green. we can ship quickstarts with a note about okhttp in the migration section. @ReleaseCo can you assist with the messaging?
ReleaseCo: will draft release note blurb: "No okhttp upgrade in this release; see migration guide for manual update steps." will post draft to /releases channel after CI green.
Mateo R.: update: fixed flaky test in auth_cli, pushed commit, CI rerun. PR #482 now shows all checks passing except one lint warning in sample-app-web. small fix incoming.
Jin K.: I opened docs PR #709 to update init snippet and added a short migration note under "Known Issues". link: https://docs.internal/pr/709. no other content changes planned.
Alex M.: excellent. final checklist before freeze: 1) PRs labeled `devex/critical-before-freeze` — yes. 2) CI green — pending lint fix. 3) docs PR open for any code changes — done. 4) changelog cutoff: set to 09:30 PT tomorrow (30m after freeze) for any last-minute notes. please leave any changelog items as comments on docs PR #709.
Priya S.: FYI coordinating sample images: I'll start a build once PR #482 merges. tagging @ops for a small warmup of the staging bucket to avoid cold pulls.
QA-bot: smoke run complete: android=pass, web=pass (1 flaky test ignored), server=pass. all critical flows OK. report: https://ci.internal/artifacts/6789/report.html :white_check_mark:
Alex M.: thanks QA-bot and team. unless anyone objects, I'll post the freeze announcement channel-wide at 08:50 PT and lock the docs repo at 09:00 PT. if others need to land hotfixes, escalate to me or @ReleaseCo with a short justification.
Mateo R.: no objections. will merge PR #482 after the lint fix (pushing now).
Jin K.: will monitor docs CI and quickstart preview — ping me if previews fail, I'll roll back the preview build and run locally.
Priya S.: once merged, I'll kick off the sample image build and tag it `devex/rc-quickstarts-202`. ETA 30m after merge.
Alex M.: perfect. last call: anything else to add? :bell:
Mateo R.: tiny ask: can we add a one-liner in the release notes to remind devs to regenerate client stubs if they're using the auth helper? saves support churn.
ReleaseCo: added to draft. I'll post the final release note and a short tweet-sized blurb for internal comms once images are canned.
Alex M.: great. thanks everyone — i'll send the freeze ping and the changelog cutoff reminder in ~10m. :shipit:
